summary.en: A differential equation relates a function to its own derivative; separable and linear first-order equations are the two types that can be solved by direct integration, giving a family of solutions narrowed by an initial condition.
summary.et: Diferentsiaalvõrrand seob funktsiooni tema enda tuletisega; eralduvate muutujatega ja lineaarsed esimest järku võrrandid on kaks tüüpi, mida saab lahendada otsese integreerimisega, andes lahendite pere, mida algtingimus kitsendab.
